title: Welcome to My Art Journey
excerpt: A brief introduction to my artistic practice and inspiration.
content:
Welcome to my website! I'm Melina Axelrad, a 21-year-old artist based in Arlington, Virginia.

My Inspiration

My passion for painting comes from my late grandmother, Florence-ann, who was an exceptional multimedia artist. She always encouraged my creative endeavors and taught me to see the beauty in everyday scenes.

My Process

I primarily work with oil paints, which allow me to achieve rich color saturation and smooth blending. My work explores lighting and shapes in landscapes, from intimate backyard scenes to expansive mountain vistas and ocean views.

Each painting is a meditation on place and memory, capturing moments of light and atmosphere that feel both familiar and transcendent.

Thank you for visiting, and I hope my work resonates with you.

title: February Exhibitions
excerpt: Excited to announce 4 weeks of work exhibition in February!
content:
The Arlington Philharmonic will be hosting a concert, art show, and sale on February 6 and 7 at the Central United Methodist Church in Ballston.

The opening reception for the art show & sale will take place on Friday, February 6, 5:00-7:00 PM alongside a Philharmonic quartet. On Saturday, February 7, the show & sale will take place from 12:00-6:30 PM. The Philharmonic will perform a woodwind concert on Saturday evening from 5:00-6:15 PM.

I will have three works on display. Please come say hi, and see some amazing Arlington Artists!

I am beyond thrilled to announce that my painting, \Delilah in the leaves\, will be available on exhibition at Langston Boulevard Alliance's (LBA) Look Arlington An Unexpected Arts Experience!

The exhibition will be three weekends: February 20-22, February 27-March 1, and March 6-8, at 3130 Langston Boulevard, Arlington, VA

Please visit Look Arlington’s website, https://www.lookarlington.com/!
